verified: The New York Times reported on November 23, citing unnamed sources, that Elon Musk told SpaceX employees the company is falling behind in AI and that renting data-center computing to competitors, including Anthropic, is more lucrative than using it to improve SpaceX's own products; Quartz and Fortune have likewise reported that SpaceX leases compute capacity to AI companies.
unconfirmed: SpaceX has not publicly confirmed the internal meeting, Musk's remarks, or which companies are customers — the Times account rests entirely on people it does not name, and no contract terms, capacity figures, or revenue numbers have been disclosed. Quartz's headline names Google as a customer alongside Anthropic, while the Times summary names only Anthropic, so the full customer list remains unconfirmed.

verified: 据《纽约时报》11月23日报道（Techmeme 转引），马斯克已告知 SpaceX 员工公司在前沿 AI 上落后，并认为把数据中心的算力出租给竞争对手（包括 Anthropic）比用于改进自家产品更赚钱；Quartz 同日报道亦如此表述。
unconfirmed: SpaceX 与马斯克本人均未公开确认上述内部讲话，相关说法全部来自《纽约时报》的匿名消息源；报道未披露租赁合同的规模、金额、期限，也未说明出租算力具体挤占了多少内部 AI 研发资源。客户名单亦不一致：Techmeme 与《纽约时报》摘要仅点名 Anthropic，而 Quartz 标题及《纽约时报》文章链接同时提到 Google，Google 是否为租户尚无独立证实。

titles.en: Musk told SpaceX staff it lags in AI as renting compute pays more, NYT reports
titles.zh: 马斯克称SpaceX在AI上落后，出租算力比自用更赚钱，《纽约时报》报道
